package.name: kotek_wall_mount_task
package.description: Orchestrates the wall-mount task's 4 pick+magnetic-mount cycles by calling GraspObject/PlaceObject directly against 8 fixed, pre-measured arm-frame poses. The robot spawns already parked at the wall's standoff (see build_wall_stage.py) and never drives, so this deliberately does NOT go through kotek_task_coordinator's FSM (task_fsm.hpp/ task_coordinator_node.cpp) -- that machinery exists for driving between a sensed pickup and a separate delivery point, which this task doesn't need.
